description: Implementation of the Project for the Construction of 300 Housing Units at Arunodaya Mawatha, Obeysekarapura, Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2020-03-04 to implement the project for the construction of 300 Housing Units at Arunodaya Mawatha, Obeysekarapura, Rajagiriya, one of the 06 sub-projects of the Project for the construction of 4,074 Housing Units under a loan assistance of US$ 200 million from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. Due to the poor performance of the contractor of the said project, the relevant Contract Agreement has been cancelled and bids have been invited under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure to select a suitable contractor to re-commence the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the contract for the implementation of the Project to construct 300 Housing Units at Arunodaya Mawatha, Obeysekarapura, Rajagiriya, to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee pertaining to the 06 bids submitted, was approved by the Cabinet.
